name: Command
description: Filters and ranks commands as users type, with an optional floating palette.

filter.description: Ranks an item for a search: 0 hides it, higher scores sort first. The default ranks a prefix over a word start over a substring over a keyword.

when: A keyboard shortcut that jumps anywhere
Action lists too long to scan
Search across everything the app can do
whenNot: Picking a value for a form (use Select or Combobox)
guidelines: Use Command.Dialog for the summon-anywhere palette; Command itself is frameless and sits in a Popover or a page as is
Group by category once the list gets long; group labels separate groups, never lines
Add keywords so aliases and synonyms match
Pass loading to Command.List while results load, and Command.Error with onRetry when they fail
accessibility: Combobox and listbox pattern: aria-expanded follows whether any result shows
The first match is active after every search change, so Return runs it
ArrowUp/ArrowDown move in ranked order, Home/End jump to first/last
aria-activedescendant tracks the active row; Empty, Searching and the error row are not options
The error row is a polite status with a danger glyph beside the words, so colour is never the only signal

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Search row over a flat list.
examples.code:
<Command>
  <Command.Input placeholder="Type a command…" />
  <Command.List>
    <Command.Item onSelect={() => {}}>Open File</Command.Item>
    <Command.Item onSelect={() => {}}>Save Document</Command.Item>
    <Command.Item onSelect={() => {}}>Print</Command.Item>
    <Command.Empty>No results found.</Command.Empty>
  </Command.List>
</Command>

examples.name: Palette
examples.description: Command.Dialog: a scrim and the raised panel near the top, key hints underneath; running an item closes it.
examples.code:
const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);

<Command.Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
  <Command.Input placeholder="Search commands…" />
  <Command.List>
    <Command.Group heading="Actions">
      <Command.Item onSelect={() => {}}>New File</Command.Item>
      <Command.Item onSelect={() => {}}>Open Recent</Command.Item>
    </Command.Group>
    <Command.Group heading="Settings">
      <Command.Item onSelect={() => {}}>Preferences</Command.Item>
    </Command.Group>
    <Command.Empty>No results found.</Command.Empty>
  </Command.List>
</Command.Dialog>

examples.name: Loading and error
examples.description: A busy list shows Searching after a second; a failed load offers Retry.

relations.note: Command.Dialog is the palette; plain Dialog is for tasks with a form
Command uses Listbox-like keyboard navigation internally
Use Combobox for form field selection with search

propsSummary: filter(value, search, keywords) => score: 0 hides, higher sorts first
Command.Item: value, keywords, disabled, onSelect(value, event)
Command.Dialog: open, defaultOpen, onOpenChange, label, footer
